# Cortex Crew

> A student competition team at Daffodil International University, Dhaka,
> Bangladesh. Cortex Crew builds working systems and demonstrates them live at
> project showcases and hackathons. The team has five competition results from
> 2026: two podium finishes and three finals reached. It is now moving into
> Capture the Flag.

Site: https://cortexcrew.vercel.app/
Founded: 2026
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Tagline: Code · Collaborate · Conquer

## Competition record (2026)

| Result | Event | Organiser | Date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Champion | CSAD 2026 Project Showcasing Competition | Cyber Security Centre, Daffodil International University | January 2026 |
| 1st Runners-up | IEEE ICADHI 2026 Project Showcase | IEEE DIU Student Branch | June 2026 |
| Finalist | AI Project Competition 2026 | Dept. of CSE, Daffodil International University | July 2026 |
| Finalist | 5th Data Science Summit | Daffodil International University | July 2026 |
| Finalist | AI Innovation Hackathon 2026 — From Learning to Impact | Dept. of CSE, Daffodil International University | July 2026 |

Five competition results: one championship, one runners-up, three finals
reached. "Finalist" means the team reached the final round and did not place.
This table lists results only — competitions entered without reaching a final
are not listed and are not counted.

## Projects

- **Darktrace3** — A breach-exposure checker built from malware and infostealer
  logs. Unlike breach-notification services, it can tell a person they were
  compromised by a stealer and show which sites and accounts were exposed, so
  they know exactly what to secure. Passwords are masked; built for awareness.
  Python, Flask, SQLite. Champion at CSAD 2026.
- **Niro** — Patient-owned medical records with a Bangla AI document analyser
  and on-demand doctor verification. FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Azure OpenAI.
  Taken to two competitions, best result 1st Runners-up at IEEE ICADHI 2026.
- **Autopilot** — A self-healing GPU cluster. Predicts GPU failure roughly 100
  seconds ahead from telemetry, then cordons the node and migrates the running
  job automatically. Precision 0.87, recall 0.94, versus 24 seconds of warning
  from the industry-standard XID signal. Python, LightGBM, FastAPI, Kubernetes.
  Source: https://github.com/kawsher-hridoy/autopilot
- **AI Mentor** — An early-warning system for university mentoring. A
  deterministic engine scores students across eight academic and attendance
  signals, then an AI turns the numbers into a plain-language brief.
  Source: https://github.com/kawsher-hridoy/DIU-AI-Mentor

## Focus areas

Project showcases, hackathons, and Capture the Flag. Technical strengths span
machine learning, cyber security, cloud infrastructure, and full-stack product
development.
